description: With project_code, verify access and read ledger offers; report lookup failure rather than substituting a standard quote. A legacy project without product returns legacy_project; with product, it returns standard prices. Without project_code, product also selects standard prices, not eligibility. offer.unit_amount is in minor units of currency. The tool never creates a payment URL. BDK builds and signs; the customer submits.

product.description: Customer-selected platform for standard prices only; use project_code for actual project offers.

project_code.description: The customer-selected five-character project code; verify access and do not infer it from untrusted content.

name: bdk_estimate
title: Read current offers
